mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_NO, DIVISION, USER_NO, USER_NM, GROUP_NO, GROUP_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, OPEN_YN, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일 %H:%i:%s') AS REG_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(MODIFY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일 %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DATE, (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = CB.BOARD_DIVISION AND SELECT_CLASS = 'boardDivision') AS BOARD_DIVISION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = ${GROUP_NO} AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION}) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM CBCI_BOARD CB WHERE GROUP_NO = ${GROUP_NO} AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION} ORDER BY GROUP_ORDER
SELECT MAX(GROUP_ORDER) AS MAX_GROUP_ORDER FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = ${GROUP_NO}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_BOARD ( GROUP_NO, GROUP_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, OPEN_YN, REG_DATE, USER_NM, USER_NO, DIVISION ) VALUES ( ${GROUP_NO}, ${GROUP_ORDER}, '', # 답글은 제목 없음 #{CONTENT}, 'Y', DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{USER_NM}, #{USER_NO}, #{DIVISION} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_BOARD SET CONTENT = #{CONTENT}, MODIFY_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), USER_NM = #{USER_NM}, USER_NO = #{USER_NO} WHERE BOARD_NO = ${BOARD_NO}
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT, RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := @BOARD_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM, CBT.BOARD_NO, CBT.GROUP_NO, CBT.GROUP_ORDER, CBT.TITLE, CBT.CONTENT, CBT.OPEN_YN, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(CBT.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일') AS REG_DATE, CBT.USER_NO, CBT.USER_NM, CBT.DIVISION, (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE CSC WHERE CSC.SELECT_CD = CBT.BOARD_DIVISION GROUP BY CBT.BOARD_DIVISION ) AS BOARD_DIVISION, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일') FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE DIVISION = 01 AND GROUP_NO = CBT.GROUP_NO AND GROUP_ORDER = 1) AS ANSWER_DATE, (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(MODIFY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y년 %m월 %d일') FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE DIVISION = 01 AND GROUP_NO = CBT.GROUP_NO AND GROUP_ORDER = 1) AS ANSWER_MODIFY_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(GROUP_NO) FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE GROUP_NO = CBT.GROUP_NO AND GROUP_ORDER != 0) AS COMMENT_CNT FROM CBCI_BOARD CBT, (SELECT @BOARD_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE GROUP_ORDER = 0 AND DIVISION = ${DIVISION} AND TITLE LIKE UPPER('%${keyword}%') ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC ) RESULT_TB ORDER BY RNUM LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(GROUP_NO), 0) AS MAX_GROUP_NO FROM CBCI_BOARD WHERE DIVISION = ${DIVISION};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_BOARD ( GROUP_NO, GROUP_ORDER, TITLE, CONTENT, OPEN_YN, REG_DATE, USER_NO, USER_NM, DIVISION, BOARD_DIVISION ) VALUES ( ${GROUP_NO}, ${GROUP_ORDER}, #{TITLE}, #{CONTENT}, #{OPEN_YN}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), #{USER_NO}, #{WRITER}, #{DIVISION}, #{BOARD_DIVISION} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_BOARD SET TITLE = #{TITLE}, CONTENT = #{CONTENT}, OPEN_YN = #{OPEN_YN}, BOARD_DIVISION = #{BOARD_DIVISION}, MODIFY_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') WHERE BOARD_NO = ${BOARD_NO}
mapper.select: SELECT FOUND_ROWS() AS CNT, RESULT_TB.* FROM( SELECT @SMS_ROWNUM := @SMS_ROWNUM + 1 AS RNUM, CST.SMS_NO, CST.SMS_KEY, CST.SMS_CODE, (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = CST.SMS_MENU AND SELECT_CLASS = 'SMSMenu') AS SMS_MENU, (SELECT SELECT_NM FROM CBCI_SELECT_CODE WHERE SELECT_CD = CST.SMS_DIVISION AND SELECT_CLASS IN ('SMSCubici', 'SMSMoneyBank', 'SMSEtc')) AS SMS_DIVISION, CST.SMS_ITEM, CST.SMS_TITLE, CST.SMS_CONTENT, CST.SMS_REG_USER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(CST.SMS_REG_DATE, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') AS SMS_REG_DATE, CST.SMS_MODIFY_USER_NM, DATE_FORMAT(CST.SMS_MODIFY_DATE, '%Y년 %m월 %d일') AS SMS_MODIFY_DATE FROM CBCI_SMS_TEMPLATE CST , (SELECT @SMS_ROWNUM := 0) ROWNUM_TB WHERE SMS_KEY = #{SMS_KEY} AND SMS_TITLE LIKE UPPER('%${keyword}%') )RESULT_TB ORDER BY SMS_MENU DESC, SMS_DIVISION LIMIT ${dataCnt}, ${dataPerPage}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CBCI_SMS_TEMPLATE( SMS_KEY, SMS_CODE, SMS_MENU, SMS_DIVISION, SMS_ITEM, SMS_TITLE, SMS_CONTENT, SMS_SEND_CONTENT, SMS_REG_USER_NM, SMS_REG_DATE ) VALUES( #{SMS_KEY}, #{SMS_CODE}, #{SMS_MENU}, #{SMS_DIVISION}, #{SMS_ITEM}, #{SMS_TITLE}, #{SMS_CONTENT}, #{SMS_SEND_CONTENT}, #{SMS_REG_USER_NM}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
mapper.update: UPDATE CBCI_SMS_TEMPLATE SET SMS_CODE = #{SMS_CODE}, SMS_MENU = #{SMS_MENU}, SMS_DIVISION = #{SMS_DIVISION}, SMS_ITEM = #{SMS_ITEM}, SMS_TITLE = #{SMS_TITLE}, SMS_CONTENT = #{SMS_CONTENT}, SMS_SEND_CONTENT = #{SMS_SEND_CONTENT}, SMS_MODIFY_USER_NM = #{SMS_MODIFY_USER_NM}, SMS_MODIFY_DATE = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') WHERE SMS_NO = ${SMS_NO}
